research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Printify is researching methods and systems for analyzing the quality of a design printed on a substrate, such as a garment, as described in Automated garment print quality control for garment tracking, processing. These developments focus on evaluating both the properties of the garment and the quality of the printed design, supporting enhanced quality control in print on demand dropshipping. The research addresses automated quality assessment and garment tracking within the print-on-demand workflow.

overview_description.description:
Printify is the world's most famous print-on-demand platform designed to help anyone with an internet connection unlock the freedom that comes with opening your own online business. And because it’s completely risk free, more than 10 million people have signed up to open their stores! 
We created Printify so that anyone can create great products, drive sales, and unlock their freedom. Printify has been on a steep growth curve since 2015, and now with more than 700 employees, three offices, and an amazing diverse team spread around Europe, we’re continuing to go from strength to strength. The Financial Times has ranked us as a Best Startup Employer for the last 4 years in a row, and we’re headquartered in Riga with  investment backing from Richard Branson, Index Ventures, and some of the best angel investors from Silicon Valley and beyond.

product.name: Printify Product Creator
product.description: A design and product-configuration tool for applying artwork to customizable merchandise and preparing products for sale.

product.description: An online tool that generates product preview images showing custom designs applied to merchandise for use in listings and marketing.
